summary: Raytech Holding Limited furnished a Form 6-K on September 9, 2026, announcing that effective at the open on September 10, 2026 its ordinary shares will trade on the Nasdaq Capital Market under the new corporate name Atlas Trinity Tech Limited and ticker ATTT, following prior disclosure in its September 1, 2026 Form 6-K. No shareholder action is required and the CUSIP remains unchanged; the amended and restated BVI memorandum and articles and a press release are furnished as exhibits. This is a routine administrative name/ticker change, not a special situation; no deal terms, board recommendation or advisor apply.
